categories.main_business_segments: Guangdong Xiongsu Technology Group Co., Ltd. primarily engages in the research, development, production, and sales of plastic pipes and related products. Their product portfolio includes PVC, PE, and PPR series pipes and fittings, serving applications in building water supply and drainage, municipal sewage, underground communication, high-pressure power cable protection, agriculture irrigation, and smart grid construction. The company operates six major production bases across China.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company utilizes advanced polymer materials such as PVC, PE, and PPR, employing co-extrusion and gas-phase copolymerization technologies. It has a strong R&D capability with over 100 patents and a CNAS-accredited engineering laboratory. Production methods include continuous extrusion and molding processes, with ongoing innovations in material formulations, product structures, and manufacturing efficiency to enhance product performance and differentiation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include distributors, large enterprise groups, government procurement entities, and major project developers primarily in the construction, municipal infrastructure, agriculture, water environment management, and smart grid sectors. The company serves both domestic markets across various Chinese provinces and international markets, with a focus on B-end customers and strategic large clients.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Guangdong (Foshan), Guangxi (Nanning), Henan (Xinxiang), Jiangxi (Yichun), Hainan (Haikou), and Yunnan (Yuxi). Its sales network covers major provinces, prefecture-level cities, and important county-level cities, with some export sales contributing to revenue. The South China region accounts for the majority of sales.
categories.supply_chain_position: Xiongsu Technology operates primarily in the midstream segment of the plastic pipe supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembling plastic pipes and fittings. It procures raw materials like PVC, PE, and PPR from upstream suppliers and sells finished products downstream to distributors and end users in construction and infrastructure sectors.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in new materials, product upgrades, and production process improvements. Key R&D projects include developing noise-reducing PVC pipes, high-gloss exterior pipes, low TOC polyolefin water pipes, enhanced structural pipes, and antimicrobial drinking water pipes. It aims to strengthen product differentiation, improve quality, and expand its product matrix to meet diverse market demands.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through the sale of plastic pipe products and related fittings. The company employs a sales model dominated by distributors complemented by direct sales to large customers and government projects. Revenue streams include domestic and export sales, with product sales accounting for the vast majority of income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as one of the leading plastic pipe manufacturers in China, ranking among the top in production capacity and product variety. It competes in a fragmented market characterized by one dominant leader (China Liansu) and multiple smaller players. The industry is highly competitive with price pressures and increasing demands for quality and brand recognition.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 1.03 billion, a 20.21% decline from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 111 million. The company experienced significant profit contraction due to decreased sales volume and prices, increased credit impairment losses, and asset write-downs. Despite current challenges, it maintains substantial production capacity near 500,000 tons annually and continues investing in capital projects and R&D.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: Xiongsu Technology emphasizes its strengths in environmental friendliness, safety, hygiene, and high performance of its plastic pipe products. It leverages advanced technology, comprehensive product specifications, and strong brand recognition to deliver differentiated products tailored to diverse applications. The company also highlights its extensive sales and service network, quality management systems, and innovation-driven product upgrades as key competitive advantages.
